ideas.pitch: A predictive machine learning dashboard forecasting peak power loads and renewable energy output across Rutgers university buildings using historical weather and consumption data.
ideas.title: Rutgers Campus Energy Micro-Grid Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the successful pipeline and rigorous statistical methodology of the Apart Research AI Forecasting winner, which judges favor for depth over simple UI demos.

ideas.pitch: An AI-driven risk scoring platform for local New Brunswick municipal regulators to automate safety and zoning compliance checks using graph intelligence and explainable machine learning.
ideas.title: New Brunswick Local Business Risk & Compliance Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the high-impact B2B vertical approach of the DIGITIMES AI Innovation Hackathon winner by targeting administrative utility with explainable metrics.

ideas.pitch: A secure campus marketplace for student services featuring automated USDC escrow payments to eliminate transaction fraud and simplify peer commerce.
ideas.title: Student Budget Peer-to-Peer Escrow Marketplace
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven market utility and decentralized trust mechanics of the Synthesis Hackathon winning Dispatch platform.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition app that aggregates daily Rutgers dining hall menus to generate hyper-personalized, macro-balanced meal recommendations and health plans for students.
ideas.title: Rutgers Dining Hall Nutrition & Meal Prep Optimizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the direct-to-consumer utility blueprint of the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon winner, making it immediately relatable and easy for judges to test live.

ideas.pitch: An interactive multi-agent support platform built with LangGraph and RAG to guide student groups through sustainability initiative applications and grant submissions.
ideas.title: Campus Sustainability Multi-Agent Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Employs advanced agentic workflows proven effective at the GreenNovation Hackathon, offering deep technical complexity beyond a basic wrapper.
